request: Advanced-route deliverable: CENTCOM supplier concentration risk. Pull DoD contract awards from USASpending.gov filtered to CENTCOM-adjacent place-of-performance countries (BH/IQ/JO/KW/OM/QA/SA/SY/YE/AF/EG/IR/LB/IL/KZ/KG/TJ/TM/UZ/PK), rolling 12-month window (2025-07-24 through 2026-07-24). Enrich with NAICS flattening, days_of_performance, open_window_flag, and per-prime trend / concentration / schedule-slip indicators. Publish two DSes on Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent parent. CENTCOM-adjacency is a proxy via place-of-performance country codes; USASpending does not carry combatant-command tags.

sources.name: USASpending CENTCOM DoD Awards 12mo
sources.description: USASpending.gov spending_by_award API, DoD top-tier awarding agency, place-of-performance country codes in the CENTCOM AOR proxy set, rolling 12-month window ending 2026-07-24. Award types A/B/C/D. Public, keyless. POST + JSON body; pagination via page in body with page_metadata.hasNext cursor termination.

args.name: CENTCOM Supplier Trend
args.features_description: Per-award CENTCOM-adjacent DoD contract records with derived days_of_performance, open_window_flag (End Date >= today), slip_flag (End Date <= today - 90d), naics_code, and calendar features.
args.stats_description: Long-form per-prime and per-sub-agency award statistics over a 12-month rolling window in the CENTCOM AOR. Includes monthly award count, 30-day rolling counts, dollar-weighted average award size, HHI-like concentration signals, and anomaly flags.

outputs.name: CENTCOM Supplier Awards Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level DoD contract awards with CENTCOM-adjacent place-of-performance (20-country AOR proxy set) over a rolling 12-month window ending 2026-07-24. Award types A/B/C/D. Includes Award ID, Recipient Name, Awarding Sub Agency (Army/Navy/AF/DLA/etc.), Award Amount, Award Type, Start/End dates, Description, naics_code + naics_description, days_of_performance, Place of Performance Country Code + State Code, plus calendar features (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Source: api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award. Refresh: monthly.

Advanced-route notes: CENTCOM-adjacency is a proxy via place-of-performance country codes (BH/IQ/JO/KW/OM/QA/SA/SY/YE/AF/EG/IR/LB/IL/KZ/KG/TJ/TM/UZ/PK). USASpending does not expose combatant-command tags. Prime-award tier only; sub-contracts and IDVs are excluded.

outputs.name: CENTCOM Supplier Risk Stats
outputs.description: Long-form per-Recipient and per-Awarding-Sub-Agency statistics for DoD awards in the CENTCOM AOR proxy set (rolling 12mo). Includes 30-day rolling counts, monthly counts, YoY deltas + pct change (limited by window depth), z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0), lifetime rank and pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify primes with surging CENTCOM award volume or unusually high dollar concentration. Source: USASpending.gov.
